_comment: Household transaction categories for home-hub. Ordered, first match wins: structural rules (transfers, card/loan payments) before merchants, specific merchants before generic buckets. pattern = case-insensitive substring or /regex/flags, tested against the raw bank description (and a processor-prefix-stripped copy). Seeded from gennaroanesi.com (personal buckets dropped). Direction is applied in lib/finance/categories.ts: a money-IN row matching a spending rule becomes Refund, and a money-IN Transfers row becomes Contribution (a member funding the joint account). The live, editable copy is the homeFinanceCategoryRule table; this file is the fallback when it is empty and the seed for the Rules page.
